title: Capability Sheaves for Compositional Agent-Harness Repair: Controlled Quotients and a Real-Repository Stress Test
abstract: arXiv:2608.13228v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent harnesses combine retrieval, routing, state, provenance, and verification, but locally successful components may disagree on shared state. We model this failure with a finite \emph{capability sheaf}: stalks encode typed behavior signatures, restriction maps retain shared fields, and accepted runs are useful global sections. An exact finite constraint-satisfaction problem (CSP) defines acceptance, while a linearized relative cohomology class provides a diagnostic and search feature.   A controlled experiment over 20 task clusters introduces hidden interior mediators whose raw states are nuisance variables. Quotienting their coboundaries reduces the candidate budget from 2,000 to 1,000 per cluster; aligning the hidden state removes the gap. Exact CSP matches the quotient, so the result demonstrates invariance to stale representatives, not superiority over exact reasoning.   We then test the method on a discovery split from the SWE-be

translated_title: 能力层状结构用于组合式智能体-装备修复：受控商空间与真实仓库压力测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13228v1 公告类型：新 摘要：智能体装备结合了检索、路由、状态、溯源和验证，但局部成功的组件可能在共享状态上产生分歧。我们使用一个有限的能力层状结构（capability sheaf）来建模这种失败：茎（stalks）编码类型化行为签名，限制映射保留共享字段，而可接受的运行是有用的全局截面。一个精确的有限约束满足问题（CSP）定义了接受条件，而线性化的相对上同调类提供了诊断和搜索功能。在20个任务簇上的受控实验引入了隐藏的内部中介者，其原始状态是干扰变量。对其上边缘（coboundaries）进行商化处理，将每个簇的候选预算从2,000减少到1,000；对齐隐藏状态消除了差距。精确CSP与商化结果匹配，因此该结果展示了对过时代表的不变性，而非对精确推理的优越性。随后，我们在SWE-be（一个发现性分割）上测试了该方法。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于能力层状结构的组合式智能体装备修复方法，通过商化隐藏中介者的干扰上边缘，在不牺牲精确性的前提下显著减少候选搜索预算，并在真实仓库数据上验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a capability-sheaf-based compositional approach for agent-harness repair, which reduces candidate search budgets by quotienting nuisance coboundaries from hidden mediators without sacrificing exactness, validated on real repository data.
